# Funding Opportunities for International Students

Finding funding for graduate education and research can be particularly challenging for international students, especially when many fellowships and scholarships have citizenship or residency restrictions.

I've collected some opportunities that may be useful for students and early-career researchers pursuing graduate education, research, or professional development outside their home countries.

Some programs are intended specifically for international students, while others support applicants from particular countries or research conducted at designated institutions. Eligibility may depend on citizenship, residency, degree level, host institution, and field of study.

Please check each program's official website for current eligibility requirements, application deadlines, and availability. This list is a starting point rather than a comprehensive or continuously updated funding database.

## International Fellowships and Research Opportunities

These programs may support international graduate students, postdoctoral researchers, or scholars, depending on their specific eligibility requirements.

- [American Association of University Women (AAUW) International Fellowships](https://www.aauw.org/resources/programs/fellowships-grants/current-opportunities/international/) — Graduate and postgraduate funding opportunities for eligible women who are not U.S. citizens or permanent residents.

- [Fulbright Opportunities for non-U.S. scholars](https://fulbrightscholars.org/non-us-scholars) — International academic exchange opportunities. Available programs and application procedures vary by country.

- [North Pacific Research Board (NPRB) Graduate Student Research Awards](https://nprb.org/graduate-research-awards/#section-2) — Research support for eligible graduate students conducting projects relevant to North Pacific marine ecosystems and management.

- [Paul & Daisy Soros Fellowships for New Americans](https://www.pdsoros.org)  — Graduate fellowships for eligible immigrants and children of immigrants pursuing graduate education in the United States. Applicants should consult the program's current definition of eligibility.

- [Smithsonian Tropical Research Institute (STRI) fellowships](https://stri.si.edu/academic-programs/fellowships) — Research opportunities for graduate students, doctoral researchers, and postdoctoral scientists studying tropical ecosystems, with research based at STRI in Panama.

- [P.E.O. International Peace Scholarship for women to pursue graduate studies in U.S. or Canada](https://www.peointernational.org/educational-support/international-peace-scholarship-fund/) — Financial assistance for eligible international women pursuing graduate study in the United States or Canada.
